biotools.summary: MitoNGS is a web-based platform designed for high-resolution analysis of fish metabarcoding data, succeeding the MiFish pipeline. It improves biodiversity assessment by incorporating comprehensive references and a 'species complex' strategy to resolve ambiguous taxa.
